\section*{Exercise 3: Proportional Speed Control of the USV}

Plant: $G_{\mathrm{surge}}(s) = \dfrac{K}{\tau s + 1}$ with $K = 5.1$ (m/s per unit throttle) and $\tau = 1.3$\,s.

\textbf{Closed-loop transfer function.}
\[
  T(s) = \frac{K_p K}{\tau s + 1 + K_p K}
       = \frac{K_{\mathrm{cl}}}{\tau_{\mathrm{cl}}\, s + 1},
  \qquad
  K_{\mathrm{cl}} = \frac{K_p K}{1 + K_p K},
  \qquad
  \tau_{\mathrm{cl}} = \frac{\tau}{1 + K_p K}
\]

\textbf{Design result.}
\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{ll}
  \toprule
  $K_{p,\mathrm{min}}$          & $0.178$ \\
  $\tau_{\mathrm{cl}}$          & $0.682$\,s \\
  $K_{\mathrm{cl}}$             & $0.476$ \\
  Rise time $T_r$              & $1.50$\,s \\
  Steady-state error $e_{ss}$  & $0.524$ (m/s, for a 1\,m/s step) \\
  \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

With $K_p = K_{p,\mathrm{min}}$:
\[
  T(s) = \frac{0.907}{1.3\,s + 1.907} = \frac{0.476}{0.682\,s + 1}
\]

\begin{center}
  \solnfig{assign_blockdiagrams_soln_ex3.pdf}
\end{center}

The response meets the rise-time requirement but settles at $K_{\mathrm{cl}} = 0.476$\,m/s for a 1\,m/s command, a steady-state error of $e_{ss} = 0.524$\,m/s.

\section*{Exercise 4: Feedforward Compensation}

\textbf{Closed-loop transfer function.}  With $C(s) = K_p$ and feedforward $F(s) = K_{ff}$, the general result from the feedforward notes, $T = G\,[C + F]/(1 + G\,C)$, gives
\[
  T_{ff}(s) = \frac{G_{\mathrm{surge}}(s)\bigl[K_p + K_{ff}\bigr]}{1 + G_{\mathrm{surge}}(s)\,K_p}
            = \frac{K\,(K_p + K_{ff})}{\tau s + 1 + K_p K}
\]
The denominator, and therefore $\tau_{\mathrm{cl}}$, is the same as for P-only control with the same $K_p$.  Only the numerator changes.

\textbf{Design result} ($K_p = 0.2$).
\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{lll}
  \toprule
                              & P only        & P + feedforward \\
  \midrule
  $K_{ff} = 1/K_{\mathrm{plant}}$ & ---       & $1/5.1 = 0.196$ \\
  DC gain $T(0)$              & $0.505$       & $1$ \\
  $\tau_{\mathrm{cl}}$        & $0.644$\,s    & $0.644$\,s \\
  Rise time $T_r$             & $1.41$\,s     & $1.41$\,s \\
  Steady-state error $e_{ss}$ & $0.495$       & $0$ \\
  \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}

With $K_p = 0.2$ and $K_{ff} = 0.196$:
\[
  T(s) = \frac{1.02}{1.3\,s + 2.02} = \frac{0.505}{0.644\,s + 1},
  \qquad
  T_{ff}(s) = \frac{2.02}{1.3\,s + 2.02} = \frac{1}{0.644\,s + 1}
\]

\begin{center}
  \solnfig{assign_blockdiagrams_soln_ex4.pdf}
\end{center}
